dataset.note: Standard LongMemEval_S; download from the benchmark source. Not redistributed here.

system.name: Zaxy
system.retrieval: Zaxy hybrid Memory Checkout (exact + BM25 + graph traversal + embeddings)
system.reader_prompt: reader-prompt.txt (general reasoning guidance; no answer hints, no memorized answers)

judge.note: The official judge is an LLM; at temperature 0 it is near- but not perfectly deterministic (observed ~+/-0.4% / ~2 questions run-to-run on identical hypotheses).

metric: answer accuracy (QA), official judge — NOT retrieval recall

artifacts.gpt-5-full500-eval.jsonl: official judge labels for the gpt-5 answers
artifacts.note: Retrieved contexts (~1.3GB) are reproducible from the dataset via the harness and are not committed.
